newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Accidents push up Moroccan taxi insurance.
newsitem.headline: Accidents push up Moroccan taxi insurance.

text.p: Road accidents in Morocco, nine times higher than in France, have pushed Morocco's taxi-related insurance business into deficit, prompting the government to increase premiums, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
The government decision to lift rates has been opposed by taxi drivers who went on strike more than a week ago, crippling transport in Rabat.

"The insurance deficit was due mainly to increased road accidents, which are nine times more than in France and 10 times more than in Norway," said the finance ministry, quoted by the Moroccan news agency MAP.
The government imposed an insurance premium rate between 32 and 45 percent for taxis to help trim the insurance deficit, it said.
